paper.title_en: Two-lifetime model for the cuprates revisited
paper.abstract_en: Several models of the strange-metal state of the cuprate superconductors postulate the existence of strong inelastic forward scattering of the electrons, but direct evidence of such scattering is missing. Here we show that angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) provides a unique tool which can address this issue. We propose a two-lifetime phenomenological model of the superconducting state of the cuprates and we show that it explains several salient low-energy features of the measured ARPES spectra. The model enables discrimination between forward- and large-angle scattering and, in addition, gives access to the magnitude of the gap function away from the Fermi surface.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的双寿命唯象模型来解释铜氧化物超导体的ARPES谱，与奇异金属行为相关，对于理解强关联电子系统具有理论意义。
decision.title_zh: 铜氧化物超导体双寿命模型再探
decision.abstract_zh: 铜氧化物超导体奇异金属态的几种模型假设电子存在强烈的非弹性小角度散射，但缺乏直接的实验证据。本文表明，角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）为解决这一问题提供了独特的工具。我们提出了一个描述铜氧化物超导态的双寿命唯象模型，并证明该模型能够解释所测量的ARPES谱的几个重要低能特征。该模型能够区分小角度散射和大角度散射，并且还能获得费米面以外的能隙函数的大小。
